## Brand & Style

This design system is engineered for competitive exam environments (JEE Main/Advanced, NEET, UPSC/State PCS, and Board Exams) where candidates spend 3 to 6 consecutive hours in high-pressure testing sessions. The visual atmosphere rejects the aggressive, gamified aesthetics typical of consumer edtech, favoring instead an intentional calmness, clarity, and structural discipline.

### Personality & Demeanor
- **Academic & Trustworthy:** Mirrors official examination software standards (such as NTA and TCS iON) while removing their dated visual friction, replacing it with ergonomic typography and balanced negative space.
- **Cognitive Serenity (ADHD-Friendly):** Strips away distracting banners, animated ribbons, and unnecessary visual noise. Complex question stems, mathematical notations, and multi-column figures are framed with clear, non-intrusive layout borders.
- **Ergonomic Endurance:** Soft, low-strain canvas backgrounds reduce eye fatigue during sustained screen exposure under variable lighting conditions (from coaching institute labs to late-night home study desks).

### Design Philosophy
The system combines **Modern Functional Minimalism** with **Tonal Surface Layering**. Elements strictly adhere to a **70-20-10 distribution rule**:
- **70% Neutral Foundation:** Soft slate surfaces (`#F8FAFC`, `#FFFFFF`) ensuring effortless legibility of complex equations and diagrams.
- **20% Structural & Interactive Elements:** Deep Indigo (`#4F46E5`) for primary actions and focused test-taking anchors, paired with grounded Teal (`#0F766E`) for secondary navigational elements and progress metrics.
- **10% Semantic Signals:** Deliberate status markers reserved strictly for test state (Answered, Flagged, Urgent Timer, and Information Callouts).

## Colors

The palette balances clinical precision with reassuring focus. The default mode is light to reflect daytime institute testing labs and print-mimicking clarity.

### Primary, Secondary & Accent Roles
- **Primary Indigo (`#4F46E5`):** Used for primary commands (Save & Next, Submit Section, Primary Filters), active question palette numbers, and high-visibility focus indicators.
- **Secondary Teal (`#0F766E`):** Anchors secondary tools, reference formula drawouts, module completion chips, and side panel headers.
- **Tertiary Sky (`#0284C7`):** Reserved for contextual informational cues, test pattern notices, scoring rubrics, and marking scheme dialogs.

### Neutral Matrix (70% Canvas Rule)
- **Base Canvas (`#F8FAFC`):** The soothing slate foundation for all root viewport backgrounds, eliminating glare from pure white screens.
- **Surface Elevation 1 (`#FFFFFF`):** High-readability substrate for question stems, reading comprehension passages, problem cards, and option lists.
- **Surface Neutral Borders (`#E2E8F0`):** Fine, low-strain hairline dividers separating question stems from solution rationale panels.
- **Primary Body Text (`#0F172A`):** Deep slate-black, calibrated for contrast compliant with WCAG AAA across mathematical symbols, subscripts, and superscripts.
- **Subdued Body Text (`#475569`):** Medium slate for question IDs, section categories, passage metadata, and secondary timestamps.

### Semantic Status Matrix (10% Rule)
Semantic colors must never be used decoratively; their appearance is restricted to testing status, validation, and time thresholds:
- **Success Emerald (`#059669`):** Indicates "Answered", "Verified Attempt", or "+4 Marks Positive Delta".
- **Warning Amber (`#D97706`):** Indicates "Marked for Review", "Bookmarked Question", or "Section Time Expiring (<15m)".
- **Critical Crimson (`#DC2626`):** Reserved strictly for "Unanswered & Visited", critical negative marks alert ("-1 Negative Delta"), and critical exam countdown (<5m remaining).
- **Muted Slate (`#94A3B8`):** Denotes "Not Visited" palette items.

## Typography

Typography prioritizes continuous comprehension, reading speed, and mathematical clarity.

### Font Hierarchy & Roles
- **Headlines & Body (`Inter`):** Clean, neo-grotesque structure with tall x-height and open apertures. Highly suited for complex stem questions, UPSC analytical essay prompts, and dense multiple-choice answer descriptions. Body copy is set at generous line-heights (`1.6x` to `1.65x`) to prevent row-skipping during fatigue.
- **Formulas & Timers (`JetBrains Mono`):** Dedicated monospaced rhythm prevents horizontal visual shifts during live exam timers (ensuring zero jitter in second count-downs) and renders algebraic equations, chemical notation scripts, matrices, and coordinate geometry formulas with strict structural alignment.

### Reading & Math Guidelines
- Question stems must use `body-lg` on desktop displays to emulate print book comfort.
- Inline math (LaTeX/MathML rendered formulas) must align to the baseline of `Inter` text with a minimum line height of `28px` to prevent superscript/subscript overlaps.
- Section tags, negative marking chips, and question index markers use `label-sm` with slight uppercase tracking.

## Layout & Spacing

The spatial architecture is split into a **dual-pane operational grid** engineered for sustained problem-solving efficiency.

### Layout Model
- **Split-Screen Exam Environment (Desktop & Tablet Landscape):** 
  - **Left Pane (68-72%):** Question view, passage context, formulas, and multiple-choice interaction area. Fully scrollable with fixed question headers and sticky footer action buttons.
  - **Right Pane (28-32%):** Persistent candidate HUD, live timer, collapsible question matrix (1–180 grid), and section-switching tabs.
- **Single-Column Stacking (Mobile & Tablet Portrait):**
  - Content stacks vertically. The Question Matrix collapses into an off-canvas drawer accessed via a persistent bottom bar containing the timer, quick-jump button, and "Review" counter.

### Grid Breakpoints
- **Desktop (1280px and above):** 12-column grid, persistent dual-pane layout, 32px canvas margins.
- **Tablet (768px – 1279px):** 8-column layout, compact right sidebar (collapsible to 60px mini-strip or sheet drawer), 24px canvas margins.
- **Mobile (< 767px):** 4-column layout, full-bleed test canvas, sticky bottom navigation dock, 16px horizontal margins.

### Component Spacing Rhythm
- **Internal Component Padding:** Use `space-md` (16px) for standard interactive cards and question option blocks; use `space-lg` (24px) for master test containers.
- **Form & Option Gaps:** Options in multiple-choice questions must maintain a minimum vertical gap of `space-sm` (8px) to eliminate mis-clicks on touch-enabled coaching lab terminals.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system deliberately minimizes standard drop shadows. Heavy blur shadows add cognitive clutter and visually distract anxious test-takers. Instead, depth is conveyed through **structural tonal layering** and **crisp 1px low-contrast outlines**.

### Surface Elevation Levels
- **Level 0 (Canvas Base):** `#F8FAFC` — Houses the backdrop, split divider gutters, and global header track.
- **Level 1 (Card & Passage Sheets):** `#FFFFFF` with a 1px solid border in `#E2E8F0` and zero ambient drop shadow. This creates a tactile, clean sheet-of-paper feel.
- **Level 2 (Interactive Floating Elements):** Option items in selected state, quick-formula popovers, and question filter dropdowns receive a subtle micro-shadow: `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05)` coupled with a `#CBD5E1` border.
- **Level 3 (Modal Dialogs & Urgent Alerts):** Submission summary modals and time-up screens use `box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05)` over a 40% opacity slate backdrop (`rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4)`).

### Focus & Accessibility Rings
All focused interactive elements strictly deploy a standardized focus ring:
- `outline: none;`
- `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px #4F46E5;` (or Tailwind equivalent `ring-2 ring-indigo-500 ring-offset-2`).

## Shapes

The design system uses a balanced **0.5rem (8px)** geometric radius standard. This choice eliminates both the harshness of brutalist angular boxes and the playful casualness of fully pill-shaped consumer interfaces, projecting an organized, institutional tone.

### Shape Hierarchy
- **Base Components (Inputs, Selectors, Option Buttons):** 8px (`0.5rem`).
- **Question Matrix Cells (Number Palette):** 6px to 8px soft-cornered squares, balancing maximum click area with dense spatial arrangement.
- **Containers, Modals, and Main Question Card Surfaces:** 12px (`0.75rem`) to 16px (`1rem`).
- **Pill Exceptions (`9999px`):** Reserved exclusively for dynamic status chips (e.g., "Single Correct", "Negative Marking: -1", "Answered: 45/60").

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary ("Save & Next"):** Deep Indigo (`#4F46E5`) fill, white text, 8px radius, medium weight (`font-weight: 500`). Hover: `#4338CA`. Active focus: 2px ring offset with `#4F46E5`.
- **Secondary ("Mark for Review & Next"):** White background, 1.5px border in Amber (`#D97706`), Amber text. Communicates secondary intent without dominating the visual hierarchy.
- **Tertiary / Neutral ("Clear Response", "Previous"):** Ghost slate with text in `#475569`. Hover: background `#F1F5F9`.

### Option Selection (MCQs)
- Options are styled as full-width interactive cards rather than standard naked radio buttons.
- **Default State:** `#FFFFFF` background, 1px border in `#E2E8F0`, padding of 14px 16px, 8px radius.
- **Hover State:** Background shifts to `#F8FAFC` with border `#CBD5E1`.
- **Selected State:** Border is boosted to 1.5px solid Indigo (`#4F46E5`), with a subtle Indigo tint background (`#EEF2FF`).
- **Option Prefix Key:** Circular index badge (A, B, C, D) centered at left: 28px diameter, styled in neutral gray for unselected and Indigo solid with white text when selected.

### Question Matrix / Palette Grid
- Grid of 36px x 36px cells displaying question numbers (1 to 180).
- **Answered:** Emerald green (`#059669`) fill, white text.
- **Not Answered / Visited:** Crimson red (`#DC2626`) fill, white text.
- **Marked for Review:** Amber (`#D97706`) fill, white text.
- **Answered & Marked for Review:** Amber fill with a persistent small Emerald dot pinned to the top-right corner.
- **Not Visited:** Neutral slate background (`#F1F5F9`), text `#64748B`, 1px border in `#E2E8F0`.

### Timer Display
- Monospaced numerical readout housed within a padded badge (`#0F172A` text on `#F1F5F9` background).
- When remaining time drops under 15 minutes, background shifts to soft Amber tint (`#FEF3C7`) with `#B45309` text.
- When remaining time drops under 5 minutes, shifts to soft Red tint (`#FEE2E2`) with `#DC2626` text, accompanied by an accessible subtle pulse animation.

### Input Fields (Numerical Answer Type Questions)
- Strict mathematical input fields.
- 48px height, 8px radius, 1.5px border `#CBD5E1`, monospaced text input centered or left-aligned at 18px font size.
- Includes quick on-screen scientific keypad toggles and clear action triggers.

### Passage & Split Cards
- Left panel includes a scrollable container for reading comprehension (UPSC/CAT style) or complex problem scenarios (JEE Advanced passage-based problems).
- Features a subtle vertical dividing line (`#E2E8F0`) with an optional adjustable horizontal split handle for candidates adjusting visual weight between passage and question.
